items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: the transcription of the Sonny Stitt solo

ctx.x: Yeah. Basically though the music is there. And when you get past the things that people have to do to keep their jobs the music that is there that all of this stuff is based on is some really great, incredible music. So the kid that has to do the transcription of the Sonny Stitt solo or the Sonny Rollins solo or whatever, after he listens to that thing forty or fifty times, like he has to in order to write it down, he’s going to get the grasp of what it is inside of it. You know? And I think that’s the most…
